page.layout: One text column on the left, running from the top of the page to the foot. In the right margin, beside "ne" in the third line of the second paragraph, one small marginal mark or note. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Catchword "con-" at the right below the last line.
page.notes: The marginal mark beside "ne" is a small ornamental squiggle with a few scratched letters, not legible as text; transcribed as illegible. Stray dots and a small mark appear at the foot of the text block and below the catchword; they are not text and are left out. The speaker labels "F." and "D." are kept inline as printed. The ligature in "dictauit" (printed as ct) is written out. The line "est: cum" has a colon as printed.
